# Signalsmith Stretch (vendored)

Time-stretch and pitch-shift library by Signalsmith Audio, MIT licensed (see each LICENSE.txt).
- `signalsmith-stretch/` — https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch (commit in VERSION)
- `signalsmith-linear/` — https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/linear, tag 0.6.6

Used by `tools/stretch` (the lab) and meant for the app's native stretch module, so the phone can
match tempo and key with far fewer artefacts than react-native-audio-api's WSOLA.
